title: bug: prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs PowerShell "compact window" rows fail on HEAD 717c4019 (22 of 99 on Windows): the extracted keeper block reads $script:MoeScriptRoot, which 373dc3d4 added and the fixture never sets
description:
Found while planning task-2f22237b, whose DoD needs this suite green through Windows node.exe.

Evidence: a pure `git archive 717c4019` with Windows node.exe, `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs` gives 99 tests, 77 pass, 22 fail. All 22 are the `<engine>: <role> <kind> compact window over ...` rows, for both powershell.exe and pwsh.exe. Each fails with "Join-Path : Cannot bind argument to parameter 'Path' because it is null" at `$moeKeeperDir = Join-Path $script:MoeScriptRoot 'mods\moe-compaction-keeper'`.

Cause:
- 373dc3d4 (task-69c02444, still in REVIEW) replaced $PSScriptRoot with $script:MoeScriptRoot in the compaction-keeper and account-switch lines (moe-agent.ps1:10085 and :10092).
- The fixture (prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs:406-434) writes the extracted block to <dir>/compact.ps1 and relied on $PSScriptRoot being <dir>.
- This is the same class as f6d9c532 (landed in 717c4019): the heartbeatStop fixture lacked a helper that 373dc3d4 added.

Reach:
- The suite runs in CI's build-all-platforms matrix (step "Test agent runtime discovery"). windows-latest fails, and ubuntu/macos fail too wherever pwsh is installed.
- The WSL env -i gate hides it, because it has no pwsh.

Fix direction: test-only. The PowerShell script prelude in the fixture sets `$script:MoeScriptRoot = $PSScriptRoot`, so the mods paths resolve under <dir> as before. The wrapper and the assertions stay unchanged.
definitionOfDone: scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs exits 0 through Windows node.exe, with every PowerShell compact-window row (powershell.exe and pwsh.exe) passing, and also exits 0 under Linux node.
The diff is the fixture's PowerShell prelude only: scripts/moe-agent.ps1, every assertion and every other row stay byte-identical.
A mutant that drops the new prelude line fails the compact-window rows again on Windows.
